items.title: Steve Turré interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 29, 2021
items.q: If you look at history, Monk, and look at reality...

ctx.x: Do you pass that on to your students? Or try to?

If I think it’s going to make a difference. You know I’ve found that sometimes if you give a student that’s not ready too much you can blow their head and they miss the whole point and get off track in terms of what music is really about. If you look at history, Monk, and look at reality, we live on a musical planet. We’re not the only beings on this planet that make music. Birds sing. Frogs sing. Insects make rhythms and they sing. Dolphins and whales sing. All over there’s musical sounds being made by other…
So music for you, does it have a spiritual connection of a sort? © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-
